evidence.title: STT GDC Accelerates Jakarta Campus Expansion to Power Indonesia’s AI and Digital Ambitions
evidence.excerpt: STT GDC reports the topping out of STT Jakarta 3 and the groundbreaking of STT Jakarta 5 and STT Jakarta 6, with each of the latter facilities planned to support 40 MW of IT load.

status_wording_as_reported.stt_jakarta_3: the topping out of STT Jakarta 3

metadata.status_scope: Topping out supports a shell observation for STT Jakarta 3. Groundbreaking supports one generic under_construction observation for each of STT Jakarta 5 and STT Jakarta 6. The page does not establish MEP, commissioning, completion, or operation for those three projects.
metadata.project_capacity_scope: The page explicitly says STT Jakarta 5 and STT Jakarta 6 are each planned to support 40 MW of IT load. Each value belongs only to its named project and is not current load, gross facility demand, grid draw, generation, annual energy, or measured consumption.
metadata.campus_pipeline_as_reported: more than 360MW of AI-ready, sustainable IT capacity in Indonesia
metadata.campus_pipeline_guardrail: The greater-than aggregate is a multi-facility long-term pipeline, not an exact additive campus capacity row and not a value assignable to any one project. It remains evidence metadata only.
metadata.stt_jakarta_2_guardrail: STT Jakarta 2 operation and its 24 MW IT-load capacity are outside this construction tranche and create no entity, lifecycle, or capacity row.
metadata.classification_guardrail: AI-ready, AI, cloud, hyperscale, high-density, liquid-cooling, and NVIDIA platform-design language describes facility capability and market demand. It does not establish a normalized workload, operating model, tenant, customer, user, or installed hardware model.

They establish no typed grid connection, generation nameplate, current load, annual energy, measured consumption, or operational energy row.
metadata.locality_guardrail: Cikarang in Greater Jakarta, Indonesia is retained as an authoritative locality only. The release provides no source-verifiable point, parcel, footprint, or geometry for any of the three projects.
